start_here: Say to your AI: "Start the spring-planting profile on my herb bed, then walk me through the questions and record each answer with the file that shows it." It runs tool:work-a-piece-through-a-question-bank.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: its questions, profiles and findings are files of your own record library, named by your schema, and it writes only the piece's investigation record and your findings file.
instructions: 1. Have a library with a schema whose investigation section names the question bank, the profiles, the piece header and the statuses, and a piece folder with a header listing its tags (the greenhouse fixture beds/herb-bed is a worked piece).

2. Say to your AI: "Start the spring-planting profile on my herb bed". It reads the row with tools:list and runs python3 -I tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py --library <library> --schema <schema> start <piece> --profile spring-planting --limit 4

3. Run next <piece> to see which questions are ready, read the files each question says to verify, then record each answer: evidence <piece> --q ID --status executed --file PATH --note "what the file shows". A missing file is refused; an unchanged file is not recorded twice.
4. Run progress <piece> to see the counts, the share done and answers whose evidence changed after they were recorded (answers_with_changed_or_missing_evidence).
5. When something is worth keeping for the next piece, add finding <piece> --kind tip --title TITLE --field NAME=VALUE ... --q ID --evidence E1.
6. A recorded answer shows which files it rests on, not that it is true; say so plainly.

worked_examples.title: Start the herb bed, answer two questions, see one answer go stale
worked_examples.ask: Walk my herb bed through the spring-planting questions.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py and run for real on a copy of tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/test/fixtures/greenhouse (library "greenhouse", piece greenhouse/beds/herb-bed, an evidence file soil-test.txt added beside NOTES.md): python3 -I tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py --library greenhouse --schema greenhouse/schema.json start greenhouse/beds/herb-bed --profile spring-planting --limit 4 --objective "Spring check of the herb bed"; then next; then evidence greenhouse/beds/herb-bed --q orient --status executed --file greenhouse/beds/herb-bed/NOTES.md --note "Header lists herb, outdoor, part shade"; then evidence ... --q QN-001 --status executed --file greenhouse/beds/herb-bed/soil-test.txt --note "Seen: finger pushes in to the knuckle"; then soil-test.txt is edited and progress is run.
worked_examples.hands_back: start answers profile "spring-planting", target_kind "own", tags herb, mulch, outdoor, raised, shade, shade:part, trellis, and selected QN-001, QN-003, QN-005, QN-006 (QN-004 and QN-007 are over_limit) and writes beds/herb-bed/investigation.json. next lists ready: [orient] and waiting_ids [QN-001, QN-003, QN-005, QN-006]. The first evidence call answers {"question": "orient", "status": "executed", "evidence": ["E1"], "progress": {"applicable": 5, "progress_pct": 20.0}}; the second {"question": "QN-001", "evidence": ["E2"], "progress_pct": 40.0}. After soil-test.txt is edited, progress shows evidence {"total": 2, "matches": 1, "changed": 1, "missing": 0} and answers_with_changed_or_missing_evidence ["QN-001"]. A finding --kind tip returns piece_finding "T1" and library_finding id "FN-0001" with the file's BLAKE3 identity.
